description: Create an immutable split (vault limit: 50) with a depositor share in basis points. The live fee must match expectedFeeBP and leave a nonnegative owner share. Optionally make it default for future deposits; existing positions retain their split. A partial result names the created split and must not be retried as creation. Requires fresh JWT and auth_verify_otp in this process. Signs the merchant smart account on the vault's network through the SCX paymaster and bundler, billed to prepaid balance on mainnet. Before signing it ensures sponsorship exactly as the dashboard does: it may create a 'Merchant dashboard' paymaster client and allowlist the vault for the merchant's sponsored clients — both persist even if the transaction then fails. Sponsorship failure blocks the action. Indexer results can lag confirmed receipts; never blindly retry an uncertain transaction.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this owner action.

expectedVault.description: Vault address from the deployment you reviewed; a changed target blocks the write.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.
